'''2006 US Nationals''' was the ''Star Wars'' CCG US National Championship of 2006, played at Gen Con in Indianapolis, Indiana, in August 2006.<ref name="sf-11373-155506">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=155506#p155506 Some Nationals Smack Talk], The Honky Tonk Man (James Booker), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (8 August 2006).</ref> [[Aaron Kingery]] won.<ref name="sf-11373-156729">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=156729#p156729 Some Nationals Smack Talk], MrPurple (Matt Sokol), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (14 August 2006).</ref><ref name="sf-11373-156732">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=156732#p156732 Some Nationals Smack Talk], The Franchise (Brad Eier), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (14 August 2006).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Gen Con, Indianapolis, Indiana<ref name="sf-11373-155506" /><ref name="sf-11373-156732" />
* '''Dates:''' August 2006; on 8 August [[James Booker]] wrote that Nationals was less than five days away<ref name="sf-11373-155506" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Aaron Kingery]]<ref name="sf-11373-156729" /><ref name="sf-11373-156732" />

== Organization ==

The Indiana State Championship was played at Gen Con on the Thursday, before Nationals. Booker wrote that he and [[Brad Eier]] were the two Team Ohio players going to Gen Con,<ref name="sf-11373-155506" /> and Eier asked the Albany players whether they would be there on the Thursday for "indy states".<ref name="sf-11373-155722">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=155722#p155722 Some Nationals Smack Talk], The Franchise (Brad Eier), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (8 August 2006).</ref>

== Results ==

After the event [[Matt Sokol]] called Kingery "the Nationals champ".<ref name="sf-11373-156729" /> Eier congratulated Kingery on the win and wrote that the players got free Gen Con badges.<ref name="sf-11373-156732" /> According to Sokol only about 15 people showed up. He wrote that [[Jonny Chu]] played Hidden Base with X-wings, Kingery played Tuskens and one Watch Your Step deck started Obi-Wan and JK (V), while the Dark Side decks were mostly Hunt Down, Fear and walkers.<ref name="sf-11373-156735">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=156735#p156735 Some Nationals Smack Talk], MrPurple (Matt Sokol), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (14 August 2006).</ref> Replying to a taunt from Booker about their game, Sokol wrote that he had not played for a year and had forgotten what his cards did.<ref name="sf-11373-156821">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=156821#p156821 Some Nationals Smack Talk], MrPurple (Matt Sokol), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (14 August 2006).</ref>
